<function name="GetWheel" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the <page>PhysObj</page> of given wheel.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="wheel" type="number">The wheel to retrieve</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="PhysObj">The wheel</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
